hints.content: **Reflective (or line) symmetry** means that we can reflect a figure across a line, and the figure will remain unchanged.

##Reflection over $\overline{BD}$

Under this transformation, each point on the ellipse maps to another point which is also on the ellipse.


[[☃ image 1]]

The ellipse is *symmetric* over this line.

options.alt: An ellipse with a center labeled A and points B and D are on opposite axes of the ellipse and points C and E are on opposite axes of the ellipse. A blue line connects D to B and reflects the image of the ellipse. The image is on top of the pre-image.

hints.content:
The symmetries that apply to the ellipse are:

Symmetry | Applies to the figure?
:- | :-:
Reflective symmetry over $\overline{BD}$ | Yes
Reflective symmetry over $\overline{CE}$ | Yes
